runSummary.stalePolicy: Discovery age is not verification age. LIVE requires fresh full-detail/link evidence; list/search resurfacing cannot set verifiedAt.
runSummary.note: 12:10 diversified sweep covered Profesia, direct-company/public ATS, LinkedIn, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, Upwork, WordPress/Reddit communities and public Facebook indexing. No new candidate cleared profile/economic/activity gates. jobs-data.json remained fail-closed and unchanged.

developmentChanges.title: Proposal competition decay curve
developmentChanges.reason: Model freelance reply probability using proposal count together with listing age and client last-view activity, so keyword-perfect but stale crowded gigs automatically fall behind fresh lower-competition work.

developmentChanges.title: Student-only contract gate
developmentChanges.reason: Detect brigades whose contract or eligibility is restricted to students and suppress them before manual review unless an alternative generally eligible contract is explicitly offered.
